about: Moneyview is a digital-only, credit-led financial services platform for Middle India, operating through the Moneyview mobile app. It distributes personal loans (its flagship product) mainly as a lending service provider for 22 regulated lenders, and also runs an NBFC subsidiary (Whizdm Finance) for on-book lending. It also offers credit cards, insurance, home loans, digital gold, UPI and bill payments, with 140.28 million registered users and Rs 22,520 crore of managed AUM at June 2026.

peers.name: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited

objects.purpose: Investment to drive growth in loan disbursals under default loss guarantee (DLG) arrangements
Investment in Whizdm Finance Private Limited (NBFC subsidiary) to augment its capital base

promoters.background: Co-founders who started the company in 2014; Puneet Agarwal is Managing Director and CEO, Sanjay Aggarwal is Executive Director. Each is selling 13,548,300 shares in the Offer for Sale.

concentration.note: Top ten Financial Partners contributed 37.36% of FY26 revenue from operations (46.82% in FY25, 56.78% in FY24).

litigation_note: Material civil proceedings against directors: nil; one pending income tax matter involving an independent director. Complaints to SEBI/BRLMs on collection practices and a non-disclosure allegation about an MSMED Act conciliation petition against the NBFC subsidiary are noted in the risk index. Default loss guarantee contingent liability was Rs 1,060.78 crore at June 2026.
strengths: Large, growing user base: registered users grew from 83.27 million (Mar-24) to 134.14 million (Mar-26), a 26.92% CAGR, with 140.28 million by June 2026.
In-house AI/ML models using 100,000+ data variables; annualised losses on platform loans fell from 7.93% (FY24) to 6.95% (FY26).
Operating expenses fell from 56.42% of total income in FY24 to 34.84% in FY26, showing operating leverage.
Capital-light lending service provider model with 48 financial partners, including 22 regulated lenders for personal loans.
Managed AUM grew at a 28.81% CAGR from FY24 to FY26 to Rs 21,380 crore; reached Rs 22,520 crore by June 2026.
Loan disbursals rose 31.08% in FY26 to Rs 23,099 crore; repeat borrowers are 60.86% of AUM, indicating sticky users.
Profit before exceptional items and tax rose 67.29% in FY26 to Rs 534.01 crore on total income of Rs 3,404.27 crore.
Founder-led management team with an average association of about 7 years; over 50% of staff in technology and data roles.

risks.title: Default loss guarantee exposure
risks.detail: The company guarantees up to 5% of lender portfolios. DLGs outstanding were Rs 1,060.78 crore at June 2026, equal to 43.92% of net worth (41.36% at Mar-26, 28.40% at Mar-24).

risks.title: Rising credit losses and impairment
risks.detail: Impairment as a share of Average Managed AUM rose from 2.46% in FY24 to 4.51% in FY25 and 5.16% in FY26; impairment expense was Rs 983.53 crore in FY26 versus Rs 252.72 crore in FY24.

risks.title: Dependence on Financial Partners
risks.detail: Top ten Financial Partners contributed 37.36% of FY26 revenue from operations. Loss of lending partners could hurt growth and revenue.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow and rising debt
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative in all three years (Rs -950.90 crore in FY26). Borrowings rose to Rs 5,157 crore at Mar-26 from Rs 1,709 crore at Mar-24, mostly in the NBFC subsidiary.

risks.title: Profit quality and one-off MD incentive
risks.detail: FY26 profit after exceptional items was Rs 242.71 crore versus Rs 397.34 crore before exceptional items, due to a one-time Rs 160 crore performance incentive to the MD and CEO and other exceptional costs.

risks.title: Regulatory scrutiny of digital lending and collections
risks.detail: Business depends on RBI rules for lending service providers, DLG and NBFCs. Complaints on collection practices and on disclosures in the offer documents were received in 2026.

risks.title: Growth may not be sustained
risks.detail: Rapid growth in the past three years and limited operating history in newer products (launched from August 2024) means historical growth may not continue.

risks.title: Promoter stake falls below 20% and no proceeds from the sale portion
risks.detail: Promoters will hold 15.55% post-Offer; 31% of the issue (Rs 341.68 crore) is Offer for Sale with no proceeds to the company. Cap price is 21.25x FY26 basic EPS.

notes: Consolidated, restated, converted from Rs million to Rs crore. Q1FY27 (June 2026) stub and Q1FY26 ignored in arrays. Summary balance sheet and P&L text was garbled and reconstructed by cross-checking totals. pbt/pat are after exceptional items (FY26 exceptional Rs 206.65 crore); pre-exceptional PBT FY24/25/26 is 198.30/319.21/534.01 and pre-exceptional PAT 171.15/240.28/397.34. ebitda = pre-exceptional PBT + finance costs + depreciation (includes other income). revenue = total revenue from operations (excludes other income). borrowings = non-current + current. cash_and_bank = cash equivalents + other bank balances (excludes mutual fund/debt investments). Operating cash flow is negative because loan disbursals sit in operating activities. pat_margin/ebitda_margin/debt_equity computed (not reported); ronw is reported (pre-exceptional PAT basis); roe is reported (pre-exceptional, average equity). OnEMI basic EPS 46.80 vs diluted 21.39 as printed. Issue amounts at cap price Rs 34; total issue Rs 1,091.68 crore. Pre-issue shares 1,539,643,033 and post-issue 1,760,231,268 (label order in source text was garbled; confirmed as pre + fresh issue). Reservation: anchor 30% (60% of QIB portion), QIB 50%, NII 15%, retail 35%; employee reservation not shown.
